review_evidence: Lax604544.lean: pure import aggregator but exports 10 concept modules defining core concepts
Lax604544/ClassesAsDegrees.lean: axioms equating standard classes (NP, coNP, PTIME, NL, RE) to degrees of complete problems
Lax604544/Degrees.lean: defines 'below Q₀' as a complexity class of problems reducing to Q₀
Lax604544/GraphIsomorphism.lean: defines DigraphIso, GraphIso decision problems and GI complexity class
Lax604544/IsomorphismInNP.lean: axioms stating isomorphism problems are in NP and GI ⊆ NP
Lax604544/DegreeOfAProblem.lean: axioms for completeness as mutual reducibility and degree congruence
Lax604544/GraphIsomorphismDegree.lean: axioms for GI-completeness of three isomorphism variants
Lax604544/IsomorphismInvariance.lean: axioms for isomorphism invariance and instance characterization
Lax604544/RelationIsomorphism.lean: defines RelIsoOn - core notion of marked relation isomorphism
Lax604544/RelationIsomorphismSemantics.lean: axiom equating RelIsoOn to bijection of subtypes
Lax604544/DagIsomorphism.lean: defines DAG isomorphism with topological order witnesses
Lax604544Proofs.lean: imports 67 proof modules for descriptive complexity results
Lax604544Proofs/DescriptiveComplexity/Complexity.lean: defines ComplexityClass structure with closure properties
Lax604544Proofs/Bridge.lean: transports library theorems to concept-level statements via agreements
summary: Inspected 15 files across the Lax604544 degrees module (concepts and proofs). All files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of complexity classes, isomorphism problems, degrees of problems, and their relationships; axioms stating key theorems (e.g., NP = degree of SAT, GI-completeness of graph isomorphism); and proof files implementing reductions and completeness results. Every file contributes unique formal mathematics to the search index.
